places.name: Stone Town (Historic Centre, UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Stone Town is a historic trading hub with winding alleys, vibrant markets, and cultural landmarks.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored with a local guide.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking on cobblestone streets.

places.name: House of Wonders (Beit-al-Ajaib)
places.ai_summary: A historic palace and museum showcasing Zanzibar's rich history and Swahili culture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the exhibits.
places.address: House of Wonders, Stone Town, Zanzibar City, Tanzania

attribution.title: House of wonders
attribution.author: Moongateclimber
attribution.description: The House of Wonders in Stone Town, Zanzibar

places.name: Old Fort (Ngome Kongwe)
places.ai_summary: A historic fortification in Stone Town, offering insights into Zanzibar's defensive history and stunning views from the ramparts.

opening_hours.notes: Check for occasional closures due to events.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for panoramic views of Stone Town and the sea.
places.address: Old Fort, Stone Town, Zanzibar City, Tanzania

places.name: Forodhani Gardens Night Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling night market in Stone Town, famous for its street food, local crafts, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the full experience.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood dishes and explore the craft stalls.
places.address: Forodhani Gardens, Stone Town, Zanzibar City, Tanzania

places.name: Freddie Mercury Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the life and legacy of Freddie Mercury, the lead vocalist of the rock band Queen, located in his birthplace.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby House of Wonders.
places.address: Freddie Mercury Museum, Stone Town, Zanzibar City, Tanzania

places.name: Palace Museum
places.ai_summary: The former Sultan's palace, now a museum showcasing Zanzibar's royal history and heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful gardens and the view from the palace.
places.address: Palace Museum, Stone Town, Zanzibar City, Tanzania

attribution.title: Dares 222
attribution.author: Xlandfair
attribution.description: The Palace Museum in Stone Town.

places.name: Spice Tour (Plantations)
places.ai_summary: A guided tour through Zanzibar's famous spice plantations, offering a sensory experience of sights, sounds, and smells.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Wear light clothing and comfortable shoes.

attribution.title: Spices1
attribution.author: Photo taken by Bertrand Devouard
attribution.description: Spices at central market in Agadir (Morocco)

places.name: Prison Island (Giant Tortoises)
places.ai_summary: A short boat trip from Stone Town to Prison Island, home to a population of giant tortoises and beautiful beaches.

opening_hours.notes: Bring sunscreen and swimwear.

places.place_tip: Combine with a snorkeling trip to nearby coral reefs.

places.name: Nungwi Beach (North Zanzibar)
places.ai_summary: A popular beach destination in Zanzibar, known for its white sandy beaches, crystal clear waters, and vibrant marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for beach activities.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby fishing village and enjoy fresh seafood.

places.name: Kendwa Beach (Sunset Parties)
places.ai_summary: Famous for its stunning sunsets and vibrant beach parties, Kendwa Beach is a must-visit for party enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for sunset views and parties.

places.place_tip: Check out the local beach bars for live music and entertainment.

attribution.title: Kendwa Beach (Sunset Kendwa Hotel)
attribution.author: Zoheb
attribution.description: Kendwa Beach (Sunset Kendwa Hotel), Zanzibar, Tanzania

places.name: Paje Beach (Kitesurfing)
places.ai_summary: A kitesurfer's paradise, Paje Beach offers consistent winds, shallow waters, and a vibrant beach culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for water sports.

places.place_tip: Take a kitesurfing lesson if you're a beginner.

attribution.author: Yann Macherez

places.name: Jambiani Village
places.ai_summary: A picturesque fishing village, Jambiani offers a glimpse into the local way of life and access to beautiful beaches.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for a cultural experience.

places.place_tip: Explore the village by bicycle for an authentic experience.

attribution.title: Harvesting seaweed in Jambiani
attribution.author: Yann Macherez
attribution.description: This is an image of "African people at work" from

places.name: Mnemba Atoll (Snorkeling & Diving)
places.ai_summary: A small island off the northeast coast of Zanzibar, Mnemba Atoll is famous for its stunning coral reefs and marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for snorkeling/diving trips.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snorkeling gear or rent on the mainland.

places.name: The Rock Restaurant (Pingwe)
places.ai_summary: A unique restaurant located on a rock in the ocean, accessible by boat or during low tide. Offers stunning views and seafood cuisine.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended, especially for sunset dining.

places.place_tip: Check the tide schedule for access times.
places.address: The Rock Restaurant, Pingwe, Zanzibar, Tanzania

places.name: Nakupenda Sandbank (Boat Trip)
places.ai_summary: A beautiful sandbank ideal for a day trip, offering swimming, snorkeling, and relaxation in a pristine environment.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own food and drinks, or arrange with the tour operator.

places.place_tip: Wear reef-safe sunscreen and a hat.

places.name: Jozani Forest (Red Colobus Monkeys)
places.ai_summary: A protected forest area home to the rare red colobus monkey, offering guided tours to see these unique primates in their natural habitat.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are mandatory and should be booked in advance.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a better view of the monkeys.

attribution.author: Mnazini

places.name: Chumbe Island Marine Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: A private island and marine sanctuary offering eco-friendly accommodation, snorkeling, and diving in a pristine coral reef environment.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking required for day trips and accommodation.

places.place_tip: Stay overnight for a unique experience and explore the island at leisure.

attribution.title: Unnamed Road, Zanzibar Town, Tanzania - panoramio (3)
attribution.author: Alex Petrenko

places.name: Kizimkazi Dolphin Tours
places.ai_summary: Boat tours from Kizimkazi to see and swim with wild dolphins in their natural habitat.

opening_hours.notes: Bring swimwear, towel, and sunscreen.

places.place_tip: Listen to the guide's instructions for a safe and enjoyable experience.

places.name: Michamvi Sunset View
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint on the east coast of Zanzibar, popular for watching the sunset over the Indian Ocean.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and arrive early to secure a good spot.

places.name: Zanzibar Butterfly Centre
places.ai_summary: A conservation center and butterfly exhibit, showcasing Zanzibar's native butterfly species and their habitats.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Jozani Forest for a full-day nature experience.
